author: OddCat333
quote: GTA 6 REVIEW - WORST GAME EVER!!!Rating: 0/10 (negative marks for disrespecting Indian culture)Arey bhaiya what is this bakwaas game u people are making?? I just started playing GTA 6 after so much hype and within 10 minutes itself i saw a DEAD COW lying on the road. DEAD COW. In the middle of the street like some ordinary animal.U people have no shame or what?? Cow is our mother. Gau Mata. In India we treat cow like god and u are showing dead cow in game for fun?? And that too so close to holy Diwali!! Whole country is preparing for Diwali, cleaning houses, buying sweets, lighting diyas and these Rockstar people are showing dead cow. This is not game this is direct attack on our sentiments.I was so excited for GTA 6. My friends were saying graphics is next level, story is good, Miami vibes everything. But no. One dead cow and whole excitement finished. How can i enjoy the game after seeing that? My heart was paining. I closed the game immediately and did puja.Also the character is driving car very rashly near the cow body. No respect. In our culture even by mistake if cow comes in front we stop the vehicle and wait. But in GTA 6 they just run over everything. Very bad message for kids **** suggestion - Rockstar should remove the dead cow immediately and add one cow sanctuary or gaushala mission instead. Or at least put "Sorry" message. Until then i am giving this game 0 stars and telling all my relatives and WhatsApp groups not to **** Gau Mata. Happy Diwali to all. But not to GTA 6 developers.

author: OddCat333
quote:
The Trails series peaked in Trails of Cold Steel II. Unfortunately, as of CS3, the writing has fallen off a cliff. It was already clumsy at parts (e.g characters conveniently appearing out of nowhere, non-sensical villain plans that involve them losing to the party all the time), however, the world building was excellent, the world felt lived in with a lot of moving parts to it (for example, I really enjoyed the dynamics between different sections of the state). I could overlook other problems because of that. The writing has never recovered since CS3. Trails through Daybreak 2 is plagued with half-coherent motivations, illogical chains of events, plot that just continues rehashing the same tired villains, and a cast of characters that have some appeal, but can't hold a candle over the casts of the older games.

I believe there are severe issues in the gameplay. One issue in particular is resource management, or lack thereof. The older games, such as the two Crossbell games, had you carefully budgeting and managing resources at all times. Failure to do so would result in you missing out on rewards and content. I am currently 40 hours into Daybreak 2, and I have effectively unlimited mana items and money. I did not go out of my way to grind, merely doing as much as would be expected from a player at this point of the game. Needless to say, resource management is completely gone as an aspect of gameplay. I believe this is very lazy from gameplay standpoint.  

Another gameplay issue is the absence of bonding events. They still exist, but the amount of them is far, far smaller compared to, for example, any Cold Steel game. These have been a staple of the series for a long time, and it is odd to see them become neglected to this extent. The amount of bonding events you could view were limited in number, requiring the player to manage these bonds carefully so as to better befriend the desired characters, or even befriend all of them. This aspect is largely missing from this game as there are so few bonding events to begin with.

These three metaphorical ingredients of the older games have been crucial to my love for the series. There are more things I like about these games (such as the combat), but these three elements are nonetheless critical. At this point, I don't recognise the series I fell in love with. Please reconsider, or end these games.
game_title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II
